title: BPW-2026-0494
text:
[BUREAU OF ENGINEERING]
BPW-2026-0494
CD 1
REVISED SOLE SOURCE TASK ORDER SOLICITATION (TOS) NO.ED21-041 – ZIEGLER ESTATE PROJECT
Recommending the Board:
AUTHORIZE the City Engineer to issue a revision of the sole source task for TOS No. ED21-041 to ICF Jones & Stokes, Inc., increasing the budget authority from $36,120 to $58,921.91, including contingency, for environmental support services for the Ziegler Estate Project.
(W.O.: E1908668, C-139062)
summary: Revision of task order for environmental support services for the Ziegler Estate Project in Council District 1, increasing budget to $58,921.91.

outcome.text: REPORT ADOPTED, SUBJECT TO CONDITIONS, FORTHWITH
